display_long_description:
Make a place. Find your people.

VoidRoom is a social VR game where you can hang out, shape your own space and try something new.

**Make yourself at home** Customise your avatar’s face, hair, glasses and colours, then save your look to your VRC.LOL account. Start in your personal room or visit the Clubhouse.

**Meet and chat** Join other players in shared rooms. Talk through voice chat or use the controller keyboard for room text chat.

**Build with the Maker Pen** Place, move, resize and colour objects. Explore circuit chips and wiring, then save your room drafts to your account.

**Try paintball practice** Explore the practice yard and try the paintball markers.

**Choose your comfort settings** Adjust snap or smooth turning and movement options to suit how you play.

VoidRoom is an early preview under active development. Controls, visuals and performance are still being refined.

A free VRC.LOL account and internet connection are required. Sign-in opens in your headset’s browser. Microphone access is optional and used for voice chat.
